**Saving & context**
1. **Save a link** — auto-fills title, description, icon, and preview; you can correct them.

8. **Saved searches** — reusable dynamic views built with search terms + include/exclude tag pickers, remembering Show & View.

**Keeping things useful**
9. **Preserve a saved copy** — a self-contained page copy (the actual file for PDFs), captured once at save time; optional submission to the Internet Archive; retry if a page was unreachable.
10. **Open the page** from anywhere on the card.
11. **Edit** address, title, description, tags, note — in place.
12. **Duplicate prevention** — one address = one bookmark.

**Managing at scale**
13. **Archive & restore**, separate from **permanent delete** (always confirmed; archived items excluded from active list/search).
14. **Bulk actions** — on selected items or all-matching (whole scope): add/remove tags (with picker), read status, archive/restore, delete.
15. **Import** browser bookmarks (folders→tags, keeps titles/tags/dates, skips duplicates with a summary) and **export** a browser-compatible file.
16. **Preferences** — default sort, page size, text size; applied immediately and persisted across sessions.
